fields.hero_prompt: Build media consumption survey questions for my local newspaper that ask readers where they got local news in the past 7 days.

faq_plan.q: What are media consumption survey questions?
How do I create media consumption survey questions?

plan.angle: The searches behind media consumption survey questions want a usable question set for news, podcasts, video and social habits, and a way to trust the answers. Template lists stop at the questions. This page shows four real jobs (a newspaper readership survey, a podcast listener survey, a 7-day student media diary, and a theater's ad channel survey), each ending in a decision, and puts the craft advice where the lists fall short: a fixed recall window, one question per source, shuffled platform lists, and checking self-reports against logs.
tab_stories: The Ashgrove Gazette asks readers where they got local news in the past 7 days; 612 answer, 401 read it before 8 a.m., and the morning email moves from 11 a.m. to 6:30 a.m.
Saltmarsh Audio puts a listener survey in its show notes; 830 listeners answer, 517 listen on a commute under 30 minutes, and the weekly episode is cut from 48 to 25 minutes.
A Halvern College media studies class keeps a 7-day media diary; 46 students log their minutes each evening, and on day 7, 31 of 46 logged fewer minutes than their phone's screen time report showed.

Juniper Street Playhouse asks 1,800 ticket buyers how they heard about the last show; 940 answer, 388 name local radio against 121 for the newspaper ad, and the $2,400 monthly print budget moves to radio.
heading_shapes: Readers up before 8 a.m. get the email at 6:30
Commuters get a 25-minute episode each week
31 of 46 diaries ran under each phone's screen time
Print loses its $2,400 budget to radio
claims_to_source: Self-reports are rarely an accurate reflection of logged media use
Forced-choice questions tend to yield more accurate responses than select-all-that-apply
In self-administered surveys, respondents tend to choose items at the top of a list

chip_adds: Add one question for each news source readers used in the past 7 days.
Add podcast questions on where listeners tune in and how long they listen.
Add a 7-day media diary with an evening reminder to log minutes per medium.
Add a question on where ticket buyers heard about the last show.
